EXCLUDED.description: The receiver serves this record without rows by its own rule (for example a record it never serves from rows: several sets, another theory, a wide record without WIDE_RECORDS).

SOURCE_REFUSED.description: The theory refuses the record as a whole: no window can be made.

UNSUPPORTED.description: The record carries what rows cannot stand for: a forecast or a hand-over.

NOT_REQUESTED.description: No rows were asked for this record.

DRBOutcome.description: The outcome of one input record that carries no rows.

RECORD_INDEX.description: Position of the record in the input stream, from 0.

RECEIVER_ARTIFACT_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact artifact that will load the rows (32 bytes): the receiving module file, not the
builder. It becomes DPMDerivedBuild.BUILDER_DIGEST; a receiver whose own digest differs must not use
the rows.

START_UNIX_US.description:
Start of the first window, microseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC on the UNIX scale ($MOR
EPOCH_UNIX_US).

WINDOW_COUNT.description: Windows per record, consecutive from START_UNIX_US as the receiver lays its windows out; 1 or 2.

POSITION_ONLY.description: Position series only, no velocity series (flags bit 0).

WIDE_RECORDS.description: Rows also for the receiver's wide records (flags bit 1).

OUTCOMES.description:
In the returned request: one entry per input record without rows, ascending RECORD_INDEX. Empty in
the request a builder receives.
